$comment: Declared corrections to the ATC codes the interaction index carries for a card, decided by the medical review in docs/research/atc-index-review-2026-10-14.json. «exceptions»: a code the card must NOT carry (card + code + reason + review). «addClasses»: a class the card belongs to for the class rules although its registry code puts it elsewhere (card + role + classes + reason + evidence quoted from the product's own instruction + review); the build refuses an addition whose quote is not in the instruction. «role»: `primary` replaces a wrong code (the class joins the card's codes); `secondary` is an additional class that one component brings (owner 2026-10-14: «one drug can have many classes»; Корвалол is a heart remedy first, the hypnotic class is secondary) — it stays apart from the codes, names the component (`via`) and the class (`label`, singular) the interaction view shows («через фенобарбитал (снотворное)»), and still matches class sentences. Both are applied at build time by selectAtcCodes; the index holds the result, nothing in the app branches on a drug id. The льна посевного семена / A06AC05 exception was removed by the owner on 2026-10-14 (see «ownerDecisions» in the review). CLS2 (2026-10-15) added secondary classes for the components codeine (opioid), caffeine (psychostimulant), phenylephrine and pseudoephedrine (decongestant), paracetamol (analgesic), chlorphenamine and pheniramine (antihistamine) of combination products whose own instruction names the class; every entry quotes that instruction (OD7 in the review). CLS3 (2026-10-15) added secondary classes with `evidence.kind = "component-atc"` (component + the component's own ATC code) for combination cards the product holds no instruction of, where no quote is possible; the build refuses such an entry as soon as an instruction of the card is in the product.

exceptions.reason: Intranasal ointment: its own instruction states that the plasma concentration of the active substances is below the detection limit and has no clinical significance, so the systemic interferon class sentences («терапия интерфероном», CYP450, гепатит C) do not apply.

addClasses.label: противокашлевое
addClasses.reason: A cold remedy coded R05X (other cold remedies) whose instruction says dextromethorphan is in it to suppress cough, so the sentences that name cough suppressants («не применять с противокашлевыми средствами») apply to it. Secondary: the registry code R05X is not wrong, the cough-suppressant class is brought by one component. R05D = «Противокашлевые препараты, кроме комбинаций с отхаркивающими средствами»; the product has no expectorant.

evidence.quote: Декстрометорфан уменьшает кашель, вызванный незначительным раздражением горла и дыхательных путей.

addClasses.label: деконгестант
addClasses.reason: A nasal spray coded R01AD53 (corticosteroid combinations) that contains phenylephrine and whose instruction places itself in the group «деконгестанты и другие препараты для местного применения». The class word «деконгестанты» now means the sympathomimetic decongestants (R01AA, R01AB, R01BA, S01GA), not all of R01A, so the product is declared a secondary member of R01AA («Симпатомиметики») to keep the sentences about decongestants with MAO inhibitors and antihypertensives; the registry code is not wrong, the class is brought by phenylephrine.

evidence.quote: деконгестанты и другие препараты для местного применения; кортикостероиды. Код АТХ: R01AD53.

The drops are a heart remedy first (owner 2026-10-14), but the instruction names phenobarbital as hypnotic; N05CB = «Барбитураты в комбинации с другими средствами», the class the registry itself gives Валокордин (phenobarbital + ethyl bromisovalerianate, N05CB02).
